question: If a lens has a focal length of 25 cm, what will be the power of that lens?
solution: The correct answer is __**4D.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Given focal length = 25 cm • Power of lens = 100/f • Power of lens = **100/25 = 4D**
